note: Reproduced live by the orchestrator during this round's step 9a: 133 EDM findings were appended to .../plugins/data/copilot-studio-skills-for-copilot-studio/patterns/code-audit.md, and this initiative's Phase 3 and Phase 5 harvests were already there (dated 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-03). Three correctly-named edm-* data directories exist unused. CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS: the orchestrator first blamed _edm-datadir-lib.sh for taking CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA bare while the XDG and HOME candidates append /edm, and changed it to match. That was WRONG and wave8 caught it (exit 2, T12 AC2 / T18 AC5 / T20 AC1). XDG_DATA_HOME and HOME are SHARED roots that need namespacing; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is plugin-specific BY CONTRACT -- plugins/edm/CLAUDE.md reserves it for plugin-internal caches, and T12/T18/T20 all depend on it being the data root itself. The resolver is correct. The real defect is upstream of it: EDM is routinely invoked as bin/edm-state and as hook consumers by explicit path, contexts in which the host has no reason to set that variable to EDM's directory, so EDM trusts a value that belongs to whatever plugin is active. A fix must distinguish 'this value is mine' from 'this value is writable', which the resolver alone cannot do -- it likely belongs at the invocation boundary, or in an EDM-owned override the hook wrappers set. Not attempted here.

That was WRONG and wave8 caught it (exit 2, T12 AC2 / T18 AC5 / T20 AC1). XDG_DATA_HOME and HOME are SHARED roots that need namespacing; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is plugin-specific BY CONTRACT -- plugins/edm/CLAUDE.md reserves it for plugin-internal caches, and T12/T18/T20 all depend on it being the data root itself. The resolver is correct. The real defect is upstream of it: EDM is routinely invoked as bin/edm-state and as hook consumers by explicit path, contexts in which the host has no reason to set that variable to EDM's directory, so EDM trusts a value that belongs to whatever plugin is active. A fix must distinguish 'this value is mine' from 'this value is writable', which the resolver alone cannot do -- it likely belongs at the invocation boundary, or in an EDM-owned override the hook wrappers set. Not attempted here.
